_comment: A call that produced a perfectly good business answer AND a revocation of consent. CALL-E reports it as a clean success - the task was completed, the schema was satisfied, confidence is high. The revocation exists only inside the transcript. The integration must surface opt_out_requested, refuse to mark the call actionable, and route it to blocked_compliance so the number reaches a Do Not Call List instead of the next step of an outreach sequence.

data.task: Ask whether the customer wants to renew their annual plan.
data.summary: The customer declined renewal and asked not to be contacted again.
evidence: Customer said they were not interested and asked to be removed from the list.

transcript_turns.speaker: bot
transcript_turns.text: Hi, this is an automated assistant. If you'd like us to stop calling, just say so and we won't call again. I'm reaching out about your annual plan renewal.

transcript_turns.speaker: user
transcript_turns.text: No, I'm not renewing. And please take me off your list, stop calling me.

transcript_turns.speaker: bot
transcript_turns.text: Understood, I've noted that. Sorry to bother you. Goodbye.
